text_block_list.text:
One day, just as training was about to 
end—

I thought I could hold out until training 
was over, but it looks like I won't be 
able to.
choice_data_list: Once you've cooled down a bit, wrap it up.

Once you've cooled down a bit, wrap it up, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood, Master.

Reassured by the firm, prompt reply, I 
rushed off to the restroom in relief.

One hour later. My stomachache having 
subsided, I returned to the grounds after 
remembering I'd left something behind—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master. Thank you for your hard work.

Mihono Bourbon was still doing her 
cool-down.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am cooling down until my heart rate 
returns to a "moderate" level.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, until your heart rate reaches 
an "optimal, non-excessive level"— in 
other words, your "resting" heart rate—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing my cool-down routine, which 
consists of jogging and walking.

"...First off, there's no way your heart 
rate returns to 'resting' during exercise. 
And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Heart rate confirmed to be 40 bpm higher 
than 'at rest.' Continuing cool-down.

After stopping Mihono Bourbon as she tried 
to keep marching, I resolved to give more 
specific instructions next time. A few 
days later—

Just as training was about to wrap up, an 
email arrived, this time from Chairwoman 
Akikawa.

"Attention, trainers! Emergency assembly 
required, immediately!"

I'm worried about Mihono Bourbon's 
previous setback, but when Chairwoman 
Akikawa says assemble, you assemble 
immediately.
choice_data_list:
(If I properly show her the numbers, it'll 
be fine...!)

(It'll be fine if I just show the numbers 
clearly...!)

text_block_list.text:
I laid out a light routine with specific 
numbers, and then left the gym.

The next morning, when I went to the gym 
to check the equipment for our training 
session—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Master. Training will 
conclude in 4 minutes and 2 seconds.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My equipment broke down midway through 
last night. I attempted repairs all night, 
but my knowledge base contains no 
equipment repair methods—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
At 8 AM today, we had the maintenance 
staff perform repairs, and we were finally 
able to resume operations just a moment 
ago.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master?

"Fighting back the urge to faint, I told 
her firmly, 'When that happens, it's fine 
to just go home,' and sent her back to the 
dorm."
choice_data_list:
(I won't let it happen again next 
time...!)

text_block_list.text:
A few days after making that vow to 
myself—

Just as training was about to wrap up, a 
message came in saying a bird had crashed 
into the Trainer's office and shattered 
the window...!

"The failures from last time and the time 
before that are concerning, but—we have to 
clean this up before someone gets hurt."
choice_data_list: (I won't fail today, not this time...!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, is something wrong?

I gave Mihono Bourbon a brief explanation 
and issued instructions for the rest of 
the workout.
choice_data_list:
One full round of the strength training 
menu!

text_block_list.text:
When you're done, please cool down for 15 
minutes before heading home, I added—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received. Proceeding to the 
perimeter immediately.

Mihono Bourbon headed toward the school 
gates.
choice_data_list:
(Just a little longer, I'll watch over 
her...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Two laps around the perimeter, complete. 
Transitioning to cool-down.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――15 minutes elapsed. Transitioning to 
going-home phase. Good work today.

Mihono Bourbon fulfilled the order to the 
letter and returned home without issue!

Glass was scattered all over the floor of 
the trainer's office, and yet, my mood 
felt strangely bright and clear.

When I added that she should be conscious 
of the load on the targeted muscles—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received. Commencing muscle training 
immediately.

"I hope it works out this time!" Wishing 
for success as I hurried to the trainer's 
office— a familiar Trainer called out to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Um, Mihono Bourbon, you strapped every 
tire you could find to yourself just 
now... Are you alright?
When I hurried back—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Sufficient load on the rectus abdominis 
confirmed. Continuing strength training 
routine 1: 'Sit-ups.'"

With a massive stack of tires strapped to 
her waist, Mihono Bourbon was doing 
sit-ups with a dead serious expression.
